The Surgeon

Meet Dr. Bruce Chisholm

Dr. Chisholm’s career has been defined by a single pursuit: the natural facelift. After earning his first professional doctorate at Dalhousie University and his medical degree from Louisiana State University, he built a practice devoted to the face and has long served on the surgical staff of Eisenhower Medical Center.

A Fellow of the American Academy of Cosmetic Surgery and a published author on facelift and deep-plane techniques, he brings both science and artistry to every face he treats.

“My goal is to restore your natural appearance, never to change who you are.”Dr. Bruce B. Chisholm Meet Dr. Chisholm

A great facelift is never noticed. It is only admired. The difference between looking refreshed and looking “done” is measured in millimeters, and in the judgment of the surgeon you trust.

One Face.
One Plan.
Never a Formula.

No two faces age the same way, so no two facelifts should be the same. Dr. Chisholm studies the skin, the deeper structures, and the natural proportions of each face before recommending an approach, from subtle refinement to comprehensive deep-plane rejuvenation.

Signature technique

Deep-Plane Facelift

Rather than simply pulling the skin, the deep-plane technique repositions the deeper layers of the face to restore the cheeks, jawline, and neck with a natural, unoperated look.

Explore the Deep-Plane Facelift

Mini Facelift

A refined option for early signs of aging along the jawline and lower face, typically with a shorter recovery.

Explore the Mini Facelift

Neck Lift

Restores definition to the neck and jawline, on its own or as part of a facelift.

Explore the Neck Lift

Midface Lift

Lifts descended cheeks and softens the transition to the lower eyelids, restoring youthful contour to the center of the face.

Explore the Midface Lift
